semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 SharedObject logical hard/soft ownership and UnifiedCache notification. Native deletion is an explicit release hook; JS execution is synchronous within one realm and does not simulate native atomics. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
